title: Extract LocalAPI request boilerplate to private helper
description: whois() and status() duplicate nearly identical boilerplate: connect UnixStream → wrap with TokioIo → HTTP handshake → spawn background connection task → build Request → send_request → check HTTP status → collect body → enforce size limit → parse JSON. This 12-step sequence should be extracted to a private helper fn(path, uri, max_bytes) -> Result<Bytes> to reduce duplication and surface the protocol logic more clearly.
